The Commerce Department approved the sale of almost 580,000 Nvidia AI chips to China under a Trump administration plan to allow the sales for a cut of the revenue. 

The customers included companies that the Pentagon lists as having ties to China’s military.

고객 중에는 미 국방부가 중국군과 관련이 있는 것으로 등록한 회사도 포함되었습니다.
